description.en: Gives an important item: like RunGetItem but with the jingle J_07 (RunGetItemEx(_item, _num, 30, 30, "J_07", 0, "sysmes-item-get")). The BGM is stopped with a fade of 30, the function waits 30 frames, and the jingle J_07 plays while the message shows.

examples.case: Receiving a key item (real usage, from ev42032600.nut)
